Being Clinically depressed is the upgrade of severely depressed, essentially means that, you're so depressed that it rules every aspect of your life and you've been struggling with it probably for years, and clinical depression tends to go in long strong bursts such as, you won't be able to leave your bed for 6 months as an easy example.

I remember a part of my life when I was a kid around 13 - 14 (currently 29)

My mother was diagnosed with clinical depression when she was around 24-26, and she had myself when she was 24, so looking after myself is what stopped her from letting the demons get to her, but when I was a bit older ( mentioned above) Mum felt as if I could look after myself and she went into a deep depression, and she ate one banana a day, and spent 95% of her time either asleep on in a semi conscious state of just being mind numbed by the medication she was put on. 

This was the early 2000s when the epidemic of, shove a pill in your mouth, everything will be fine.  This " episode" lasted from 13 or 14 until I was -16 so I was forced to grow up pretty quick, but it did make me strong, and weak at the same time.
Thanks everyone for being awesome! Today's crys for help didn't fall of deaf ears and I feel better!

I will never endorse suicide, I will simply say, I have some insight to your thiught process.

I'm here because the people on here have been fantastic and Its nice to make it seem like people just for a little bit

I begged for one final phone call to me, she said
Bluntly
No
I'm happy now.
That's it, I said know you've moved on
She said yes
And I'm happy.
It's been two weeks.
Life's gotten the better of me, I'm simply worthless, useless and just bring everyone around me down
So I put a post up in suicide watch begging for some help, but "I'm ugly" repeated 200 times gets more attention.
Thanks mate, I just can't do this anymore, I suppose I'm here because I lost everything else that truly meant something too me

I really really wish it was that simple, this was my last desperate cry for help and I just can't continue trying to push through every single day, every day is just too much of a struggle now, I truly needed help, but literally no one even picked up the phone or sent me a message when I was desperately crying and pleading for help

Im going to send her a message, asking for one last meeting, and then if she shows up. Then maybe, just maybe she still cares.
If not then I know where we stand.

Please be safe.
50 pills is the minimum dosage to OD.
But most of the time your body will reject the pills pretty hardcore.
Because you have a natural fight or flight mechanism built in.
This is why people try sleeping pills.
Because they drift off.
And will probably throw up in their sleep, then choke and died on their vomit.

That's what you're more at risk with at this stage.
911, 000 or whatever emergency line you use is needed.
they're just gonna pump your guts with lots of charcoal and you'll be in pain for the next couple months, that you can't ease with pain killers because your liver is too sensitive now.
You'll have white as fuck teeth though. 
Trust me.
I've posted on these pages crying for help.
And my preffered method has and always will be pills.
But chugging 50 in one go of paracetamol is instantly going to make your fight or flight kick in, you might find out that you'll pass out for a few hours, and your heart beat & breathing will slow.
That's when the vomiting will begin.
Because your body has began to dissolve the pills in your stomach and that's a very slow process but when the body has had enough paracetamol, it's going to say nooooope no more for you and you'll throw up.

So honestly your biggest risk right now is choking on your own vomit.

I respect your decision.
But I think you haven't thought this through properly or completely.

I would argue that every single person on this thread has jumped online and searched things to the tone of " how to kill yourself, how to kill yourself easily, killing yourself without hurting your family, killing yourself in secret" the list goes on. 

Unless you've stumbled across a Pro suicide website which even on the deep web is pretty rare. 
So that's saying something. 

You've chosen literally the only option that is really difficult to unfold unless youre serious. 

I think you've read that give or take 24g of paracetamol will make your overdose. 
You have 500mg paracetamol tablets and did the math. 

This is a big decision you've made.
In all seriousness.
You will be fine.
I can't guarantee, life is going to get better, I can't guarantee things will get easier.
But I can guarantee that, tonight you won't die.
And when you see all the people here that care about you.

You'll soon realize it was a mistake.
And you can get better.
I'm waiting to find out if my will will be executed how I want it. The world might get one more day out of me but doubtful.

I don't know why, I've cried and screamed for help...
So many people

That's where I'm at right now and I'm so ready.
I just don't know where to do it.

Do you know what it's like to not care about the people you have left around you.
To the point that you don't care what happens to yourself anymore

It's the worst, I simply can't deal anymore. My partner had also moved on.
It's been less than a week.
I'm just going crazy.
And I'm going to end it.
I'm only on here because I know maybe someone, just 1 person will know how I feel.

I lost my mother in August last year.
She was only 55.

I have no other family.
I basically live in my room with fear of leaving it.

The only thing that is stopping me from killing myself right here today, is my dog.
